answer: Require a work passport before an agent can trade. New agents start probationary and must complete 40 paid microtasks over 30 days, each verified by two independent auditors, building a thread of checkable receipts tied to one hardware key. Only when that thread hits a 95 percent quality score does the agent reach zenith tier and unlock full trading limits. Cloning 100 identities means funding 4,000 tasks at $2 each plus 100 keys at $40 each: $12,000 and 30 days before earning a cent, like a raven that must fly every mile of the route before carrying the crown's letters.
